The merge kept this PR's clause that each recovery retry logs `envoy nats recovery resubscribe failed` with an `attempt`, which #2504 made untrue: recovery.go:326-361 keeps a failed hook run out of that line and reports it through reportHookFailure, and main's own AGENTS.md:2798 says so. The clause is gone in all three places; settings.go:83 keeps the true redelivery-sweep clause (redeliver/sweep.go:261).
Fixed by the reviewer in 9eddf894: retro's learning cited pre-merge line numbers that main moved (nats.go:529, :414, :523-528, recovery.go:198-215); it now cites symbols.

mergeChecks: HookedConnectionEvents (nats.go:532-543) matches main's rewatch: hookedEvents is set to the event count the run began at only after a run that succeeded (recovery.go:204, :217).

startDispatchStream keeps both sides: main's reconcileFailure matches both of main's hook messages (stream_replicas_test.go:117, recovery.go:257-259), beside the PR's HookedConnectionEvents() >= 1 wait.

The PR's 1 s pings and main's RepairGrace stall reporting do not interact badly: the tester's probe measured 0 WARN and 0 ERROR across short freezes and a 1 m 33 s freeze, and /healthz healthy about 1 s after each thaw.
Retro's commits above my last approval touch only docs/solutions/ and .legion/.
